LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of LLMs

Edward Hu †Equal contribution. Yelong Shen*
Abstract

We propose Low-Rank Adaptation, or LoRA, which freezes the pre-trained model weights.

1 Introduction

Many applications rely on adapting one large-scale model (Radford et al., 2019).111Fine-tuning boosts GPT-3 significantly. See this and the code.
